newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Malbak surges with unbundling go ahead.
newsitem.headline: Malbak surges with unbundling go ahead.

text.p: Industrial holding Group Malbak Ltd powered more than seven percent higher in early Monday morning trade, propelled by news it would go ahead with the full unbundling of its underlying assets, dealers said.
After just over 15 minutes of trade, Malbak had surged 1.50 cents higher to 20.60 rand.

"It's on the back of the unbundling announcement. Our researcher says there is about a 10 to 15 percent return for shareholders with the unbundling...This has obviously been taken as positive news," one dealer said.
"We expect volumes to be fairly large. It is likely to move a lot higher," said another dealer.
The volumshares traded so far was 111,100.
Malbak first announce in May it was was considering unbundling. It expected to make another announcement on or about October 29, when it is due to publish preliminary results.
